style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven handsome face with fine elven features and a straight, slim, normal-sized nose, lively expressive eyes, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a lute on his back, slim build. His face is full of life and follows the scene: shouting, laughing, fierce, cocky, scheming, grieving only when the scene grieves. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.valerys: Oathbreaker Valerys, the High Inquisitor fallen: a tall man in his sixties, close-cropped grey hair and short grey beard, hard pale grey eyes, his white and crimson inquisitor robes and gold sun emblem blackened and cracked, dark corrupted plate beneath, a cold dark fire and pale light burning around him
cast.serpent: the serpent: a colossal pale worm-like serpent rising from the earth, ridged grey-white hide, a huge round mouth ringed with teeth, dirt and stones falling from it
cast.kaelen: Kaelen Stormshield, a Church paladin the brothers know, now an archer with a longbow: a broad young man in his twenties, short brown hair, a square jaw, dented white-and-steel Church plate with a gold sun emblem, torn white tabard, bloodied and bruised
cast.soldiers: five Church soldiers in battered white-and-steel armour with spears and torches
cast.darius: Darius, a grizzled castle steward in his fifties, grey beard, leather jerkin, a ring of keys
cast.dolkan: Dolkan, a mad old duergar: a short, stocky grey-skinned dwarf, bald with a wild white beard, bulging glowing eyes, tattered dark leathers, a lantern on a pole, cackling
cast.wittan: Wittan, a deep gnome (svirfneblin): small, grey stone-coloured skin, bald, big nose and ears, dark eyes, practical grey leathers and a pick
cast.bulette: a bulette, a land shark, exactly as in the reference photo of the miniature: a huge armoured burrowing beast with a grey-green shell of stone-like plates and spiky dorsal plates, a shark-like toothed mouth, clawed forelegs
cast.cavern: the cavern from the reference photo of the tabletop, painted as a real underground place at full scale
cast.mindbreaker: the Mindbreaker, only ever seen as a shadowy silhouette: a tall gaunt robed humanoid with a head of writhing tentacles where the mouth should be, faint glowing eyes
cast.thorman: Thorman Earthblast, a duergar warlord: short, broad, grey-skinned, a braided iron-grey beard, heavy dark steel armour, a great war hammer, stern
cast.drow: a beautiful drow woman: dark purple-grey skin, long straight white hair, pointed ears, violet eyes, a fitted dark leather outfit with silver details, a sly smile
cast.wolf: Arthas's steed, a huge grey wolf with a saddle, big as a horse, calm
